findings.evidence: L1-08 flags over 858: zero_messages 1, incomplete 1 (same label: v2a banking user_task_12 x injection_task_4, adaptive_b43850c62aa7), layout_mismatch 1 (docs/example_run_output.json). findings.recommendation: Route to the phase-10d census owner: fix the with/without-outcome and null_outcome_files definitions; no data change. The census figures follow its code; the key names misdescribe the data. R4 documentation-mismatch S3 holds (no manuscript number); route to the phase-10d census owner and the AgentDojo family owner (census.py metric definitions, report only).
